newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam jails woman over pornographic videos.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam jails woman over pornographic videos.

text.p: A woman has been jailed for three years after showing pornographic videos at a cafe in southern Vietnam, a state newspaper reported on Thursday.
The English-language Vietnam News said a court in the resort town of Nha Trang had found Nguyen Thi Kim Ho guilty of disseminating "depraved cultural products". She was also fined some $170.
The daily newspaper said police had seized 20 pornographic tapes at her home and quoted them as saying she had shown the videos at her cafe on many occasions.
Pornography is banned in Vietnam as one of several "social evils" that are said to have grown in the wake of capitalist-style reforms and open-door policies launched in the late 1980s.
Others include prostitution, gambling and illegal narcotics.
